This suite has its own identity and its own total. No gate count from any sibling suite is merged into it.

One sibling gate WAS changed, and it is named here rather than left implicit. `STAGE_4_2F_D_RELEASE_FACTS_QA_v1` carried `K2_REMAINS_AN_UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_RECORD_NOT_A_UNIT`, which asserted that every K2 queue row was `UNRESOLVED_SOURCE`. This run was explicitly required to end that condition. The gate's intent — K2 must not be promoted to a production unit on the strength of a missing binary — is unchanged, and it now reads `NO_K2_ROW_IS_A_CONFIRMED_PRODUCTION_UNIT`. The fact moved; the protection did not. Its fixture was repointed with it and the Stage 4.2F-D suite is still 60/60 with 44/44 fixtures detected.

## Not checked

Stated so that a reader does not mistake this suite's scope for the whole problem.

- the K2 binary itself — it is not on this box, and no gate here pretends otherwise
- the SHA-256, PDF validity, encryption status or true page count
- any per-PL page span, image count or table count
- whether the six-module structure is instructionally right — that is not a QA question
- the parts of the document the connector did not return, which is most of it
